summary: Frontend-only verification of the TimeField AM/PM clipping fix on 390x844 mobile viewport. The original bug (End time AM/PM clipped off the right edge of the screen on schedule/new and other side-by-side TimeField screens) is FIXED. All AM/PM toggles on all reported screens are fully inside the viewport, tappable, toggle correctly, and persist to the backend as 24-hour HH:MM. Regression checks on desktop (1024x768), single-column TimeField (hotel check-in/check-out), and the clear (X) icon also pass. A full-app overflow scan across 11 routes at 390px shows ZERO elements overflowing the viewport (document.scrollWidth == clientWidth == 390 on every page).

critical_code_review_comments: TimeField.tsx fix is well-scoped: timeGroup with flexShrink:0 keeps HH:MM and AM/PM together; periodBtn has minWidth:40 + flexShrink:0 so it can never be squeezed below tap-target size; outer webRow has flexWrap:'wrap' + rowGap:6 so only the clear icon / placeholder can wrap to a second row.

12-hour <-> 24-hour conversion logic (parse12 / commit) is correct and the storage contract (HH:MM 24h) is unchanged — confirmed by saving 10:30 PM and observing end_time='22:30' returned from POST /api/schedule.

DateTimeField does not forward the parent testID to its child DateField/TimeField (line 32, 36 of /app/frontend/src/components/DateTimeField.tsx). Not a bug, but adding `testID={testID ? "${testID}-time" : undefined}` would make this component easier to assert against.

context_for_next_testing_agent: TimeField AM/PM clipping bug is verified fixed. Side-by-side TimeFields in /schedule/new, /bookings/new?type=flight, and /competitions/{id} (CompetitionTeamsSection) all keep AM/PM within the 390px viewport. Desktop layout, single-column TimeField, and the clear (X) icon all continue to work. No overflow detected on dashboard, schedule, calendar, expenses, athletes, competitions list, competition detail, or any bookings/new variant.
rca_of_issue:
Root cause (pre-fix): on web, the original TimeField rendered everything (clock icon + hour + colon + minute + AM/PM pill + clear icon) in a single non-wrapping flex row with no flexShrink protection on the AM/PM pill. When two TimeFields shared a row (each constrained to ~150–173px on a 390px viewport) the row's natural width (~210px) exceeded the column width, and the last-positioned child (AM/PM pill) overflowed past the column's right edge — and in the case of the End time field, past the viewport edge.

Fix verified: removed the leading clock icon, tightened paddings/gaps/number widths, grouped HH:MM + AM/PM into a non-shrinking timeGroup, gave the AM/PM pill its own flexShrink:0 + minWidth:40, and let the outer webRow flexWrap so only the clear icon / placeholder can drop to a 2nd row.

Measured evidence (viewport 390px):
- /schedule/new: start period right edge=142, end period right edge=327 (both well inside 390)
- /bookings/new?type=flight: all 4 AM buttons (depart/arrive/return-depart/return-arrive) right edge=331
- /competitions/{id} teams section: all 4 meet/perf period buttons right edges 144 and 314
- Saved end_time of 10:30 PM persisted as '22:30' in POST /api/schedule response
- AM→PM toggle, PM→AM toggle, and clear (X) all interactive
- documentElement.scrollWidth == clientWidth == 390 on all 11 routes scanned
